assumptions.statement: Official geometry, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, building condition, municipal utilities, fire safety, flood control and heritage constraints remain unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-sensitive moves remain conceptual and must be recalculated and professionally verified before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: Scenario operators, data controllers, technical maturity, budgets and service-level agreements are proposed roles rather than confirmed commitments.
assumptions.impact: Every scenario enters only after responsibility, data, human takeover, complaint and exit clauses are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Automated packaging checks do not certify bilingual equivalence, PDF reading order, colour-vision accessibility, WCAG conformance or A0 distance legibility.
assumptions.impact: A bilingual planning reviewer and accessibility reviewer must complete a documented manual audit before final publication.
